summary: A decades-old five-storey building at 45J Ma Tau Wai Road in Hung Hom collapsed around 1:30pm, amid ground-floor renovations. Firefighters searched for survivors, evacuated nearby buildings 45G and 45H, and confirmed four dead. Chief Executive Donald Tsang called for an investigation, Carrie Lam ordered inspections of buildings over 50 years, and Matthew Cheung pledged support for victims.
